PowerShell($local = \(Select-String -Path ".env" -Pattern "WHATSAPP_API_TOKEN=" -SimpleMatch\).Line; $token = $local -replace "WHATSAPP_API_TOKEN=",""; "LOCAL token length: $\($token.Length\)"; "LOCAL token first 20: $\($token.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(20, $token.Length\)\)\)"; "LOCAL token last 20:  $\($token.Substring\([Math]::Max\(0, $token.Length - 20\)\)\)"; "Has trailing whitespace? $\($token -ne $token.TrimEnd\(\)\)"; "Has quotes? $\($token.StartsWith\('"'\) -or $token.StartsWith\(""'""\)\)")

PowerShell($envContent = Get-Content ".env" -Raw; $token = \([regex]::Match\($envContent, "WHATSAPP_API_TOKEN=\(.+\)"\)\).Groups[1].Value.Trim\(\); $url = \([regex]::Match\($envContent, "WHATSAPP_API_URL=\(.+\)"\)\).Groups[1].Value.Trim\(\); "Testing direct API call from local..."; "URL: $url/messages"; "Token length: $\($token.Length\)"; ""; try { $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$url/messages" -Method GET -Headers @{ "Authorization" = "Bearer $token" } -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15; "STATUS: $\($resp.StatusCode\)"; "BODY: $\($resp.Content\)" } catch { "STATUS: $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\)"; $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader\($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream\(\)\); "BODY: $\($reader.ReadToEnd\(\)\)" })

PowerShell($envContent = Get-Content ".env" -Raw; $token = \([regex]::Match\($envContent, "WHATSAPP_API_TOKEN=\(.+\)"\)\).Groups[1].Value.Trim\(\); ""; "=== TEST 1: GET /me \(¿token válido?\) ==="; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/me?access_token=$token" -TimeoutSec 15; $r | ConvertTo-Json } catch { $stream = $_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream\(\); $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader\($stream\); "STATUS: $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\)"; "ERROR: $\($reader.ReadToEnd\(\)\)" }; ""; "=== TEST 2: GET /debug_token ==="; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/debug_token?input_token=$token&access_token=$token" -TimeoutSec 15; $r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 } catch { $stream = $_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream\(\); $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader\($stream\); "STATUS: $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\)"; "ERROR: $\($reader.ReadToEnd\(\)\)" })
